title: Gloss Motion Document
description: A keyframe clip applied to rig bones or to a hologram as bone root.

schemaVersion.description: Document format revision. Always 1 for motion documents.

revision.description: Server-owned monotonic revision, raised on every save.

durationTicks.description: Clip length in ticks. Omitted takes the last keyframe tick.

loop.description: Playback mode after the clip ends.

fps.description: Frame rate this clip streams at, clamped by the rigs module maxMotionFps.

tracks.description: Channel tracks evaluated for every frame.

bone.description: Bone id, or * for every bone. Holograms use root.

channel.description: Animated channel. Rotations are degrees, glow is #AARRGGBB, visible is a boolean.

blend.description: How this track combines with the bone rest pose. Defaults per channel: add for translation and rotation, multiply for scale, replace for the rest.

tick.description: Tick offset from the clip start.

value.description: Number for numeric channels, #AARRGGBB string for glow, boolean for visible.

easing.description: Curve from this keyframe to the next: linear, hold, ease_in, ease_out, ease_in_out, back_out or bezier(x1,y1,x2,y2).
